comments.author: @ExploreTravelDocs
comments.text:
This documentary captures Montenegro so perfectly! I visited last year and was absolutely blown away by the contrast—how quickly you can go from the sunny Adriatic beaches to those rugged, dramatic mountains. The drive around the Bay of Kotor is a core memory for me now.

For those who have also visited, did you prefer relaxing by the historic coastal towns or exploring the wilder mountainous areas inland? And if you haven't been yet, which part of this video makes you want to pack your bags the most? 🇲🇪✨

comments.text: Just finished fixing the stone wall on our terrace above Kotor Bay! Living in a tiny country of 600,000 where dark mountains plunge straight into the Adriatic sea means driving winding serpentines every day. We use the Euro without even being in the EU, but our traditional slow life remains untouched—could you handle a daily life where the sea and snowy peaks are only 2 hours apart? 🇲🇪
